units.source_text: 马咯扭头看着我们，苦笑着说：“这有剽窃歌德的《迷娘之歌》的嫌疑 。

en.t: Magg turned his head to look at us and said with a wry smile, "This looks suspiciously like plagiarism from Goethe's 'Mignon's Song.'

units.source_text: 如此看来，托喀君对当一个诗人感到疲倦才选择自杀的。”

en.t: Judging from that, Tock must have chosen suicide because he had grown tired of being a poet."
